title: Title
pricing_help: Parts: per item. Rentals: per day. Services: indicative labor cost. Blank price means “Ask for price”. Empty translations fall back to Lithuanian.
photo_help: Up to 8 photos total, 5 MB each. Check a photo to remove it when saving.
fitment_help: Add one row for each compatible make/model and inclusive year range.
fitment_error: Complete make, model, and a valid year range in every compatibility row.
archive_help: Archiving removes the listing from the website. It can be restored from the archived listings filter.
contact_customer: Contact the customer to confirm availability, delivery, and payment. Status changes do not send messages.
stock_help: Confirmation deducts stock once. Cancellation restores it once.
cancel_first: Cancel the confirmed order to restore stock before returning it to review.
notification_disabled: Email alerts are disabled: set a valid SHOP_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL and configure mail delivery. Requests are still saved here.
search_hint: Search any translated title or part number
